A simple, tasty weeknight option is **One‑Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken & Veggies**.  
Ingredients (serves 2): 2 chicken thighs, 1 lb baby potatoes halved, 1 cup broccoli florets, 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 garlic cloves minced, zest & juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt & pepper.  
Toss chicken and veggies with oil, garlic, lemon zest/juice, oregano, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet, roast at 425°F for 25‑30 min, stirring halfway, until chicken reaches 165°F and potatoes are crisp. Serve with a squeeze of extra lemon.
